voice.continueLine: Pineapple. I said pineapple. Insert a coin and we settle this.
voice.selectLine: Lidd. Like the thing on the dumpster. Yes, that is where he found me.
tauntLines: Lunch is served. You are the lunch.
I found this tray in the sewer. It is cleaner than you.
My sensei is a possum. Your sensei is a wall.
voice.endingText: Lidd went home to the pipe and found the other three had eaten his slice. The fight continues.

parodyMeta.gag: Named after what the sensei found in a dumpster; his continue screen is an argument about pizza toppings
tells: Wears a cafeteria hairnet instead of any kind of mask, because the sensei dressed him in the dark
